storyCards.headline: I'm Coming Out: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Diana Ross's "I'm Coming Out" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I'm Coming Out" is a song recorded by American singer Diana Ross.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Diamond Diana: The Legacy Collection" (2018) — not the song's original release year.

Album: Diamond Diana: The Legacy Collection (2018).
